reasons: The redline reaches the preferred LICENSE position: the grant now expressly extends to Customer's Affiliates and to contractors acting on Customer's behalf, at-will revocation ('revocable at Vendor's sole discretion') is removed and limited to the § 13.3 grounds, and transfer to an Affiliate or successor is added by deleting 'non-transferable'.

The high changed-character ratio (0.807) is justified here: nearly every operative element of the original one-sentence grant ('Customer alone', 'non-transferable', 'revocable at Vendor's sole discretion', 'without Affiliates or contractors') is the deviation, so a whole-clause rewrite is the smallest edit that cures it.

Using cross-references to § 13.3 rather than restating revocation and transfer terms is a genuinely minimal, internally consistent approach and avoids creating conflicting standards with §§ 13.2–13.3.
The comment is accurate, first-person plural, concise, correctly cites the playbook position and offers the Affiliates-on-written-notice fallback; it does not misstate the contract.
